name: mentor
description: A Codex plugin for initializing and running a sociology literature vault and paper-revision mentor workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Sociology literature and paper-revision mentor for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Mentor turns Codex into a sociology research assistant, literature-system builder, and academic revision partner. It includes a setup skill and a batch literature-reading skill designed for Obsidian-first workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $mentor to initialize my sociology literature system.
Use $du-wen-xian to process my paper folder.
Use $mentor to create an Obsidian-first revision workspace.
